import heapq

def main():
    N = int(input())
    Vs = list()
    Es = list()
    inf = 10 ** 10
    for i in range(1, N):
        Vs.append([i, inf])
        Ai, Bi, Xi = map(int, input().split())
        Es.append([i, Ai, Xi, Bi])
    Vs.append([N, inf])
    Vs[0][1] = 0

    U = []
    heapq.heappush(U, (Vs[0][1], Vs[0]))
    while U:
        now = heapq.heappop(U)[1]
        if now[0] == N:
            break
        i = Es[now[0]-1][0]
        A = Es[now[0]-1][1]
        X = Es[now[0]-1][2]
        B = Es[now[0]-1][3]
        if Vs[now[0]][1] > now[1] + A:
            Vs[now[0]][1] = now[1] + A
            heapq.heappush(U, (Vs[now[0]][1], Vs[now[0]]))
        if Vs[X-1][1] > now[1] + B:
            Vs[X-1][1] = now[1] + B
            heapq.heappush(U, (Vs[X-1][1], Vs[X-1]))
